net.coobird.thumbnailator.ThumbnailParameter param = new net.coobird.thumbnailator.ThumbnailParameter(
    new java.awt.Dimension(100, 100),
    null,
    true,
    "PNG",
    null,
    1.0f,
    java.awt.image.BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB,
    java.util.Collections.<net.coobird.thumbnailator.filters.ImageFilter>emptyList(),
    null,
    true,
    false
);

boolean fit = param.fitWithinDimenions();

assert fit == true : "Expected fitWithinDimenions to be true based on the constructor argument";
System.out.println("__CHECK__ fitWithinDimenions " + fit);
